name: Echo CS-501P
blurb: A 50.2 cc pro-oriented saw: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 66–78 drive links per Echo's own chart.
intro: The Echo CS-501P is a 50.2 cc pro-oriented saw. Echo lists 16″ (accessory), 18″ and 20″ bars for the CS-501P on .325″ pitch .050″ chain using its “LPX” chain type, where the CS-4920 uses “BPX”.

bars.note: Echo bar 16F0LD3366C; chain 20LPX66CQ. Echo’s specification table marks 16″ as an accessory-only bar length for this saw.

sources.title: ECHO chainsaws catalog (Jan 2023) — “Bars and Chains” chart: bar and chain part numbers, drive-link count, gauge, pitch and file size per saw; saw specification tables
